The Thornbury Cloth Co. deadline isn't settled yet. I've replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread with what we have and suggested she confirm with Marcus before relying on either date.

- **14 Oct, #north-team:** Marcus said the signed order form (the Thistle work) was due **24 December**.
- **Later that day, #north-random:** He corrected it to **15 August**, saying their ops lead had corrected him.
- **Still open:** 15 August had already passed by 14 Oct. I asked whether they meant next year or whether the deadline has lapsed, and I can't find an answer.

These messages are only recorded in gbrain. When I read the two channels directly, neither showed them. Ilse is a member of both, so sharing them with her is fine, and a signing deadline isn't a finance figure. I didn't use `search_messages`, DMs or any finance documents.
